text: Carpentry is a skilled trade that involves the construction or repair of structures and objects using wood and other materials. One fundamental technique is sanding, which smooths rough edges or surfaces to make them more user-friendly and visually appealing. A critical step in carpentry is sawing, which involves cutting wood into precise pieces with tools like hand saws, circular saws, or power saws. Carpentry also employs various other techniques, including joinery, which involves joining pieces of wood together to form a cohesive structure. By combining sanding, sawing, and joinery, carpenters can create a wide range of projects, from furniture to architectural elements.
